verdict.rationale: Build mode runs tasks autonomously end to end without blocking the user, and can spawn subagents for research or review. Enterprise plans also offer scheduled Deep scans, a narrow form of recurring background automation. However, nothing in the evidence shows user-defined automations that run on schedules or triggers in the background. Missing for 10: user-configurable scheduled or triggered automations (cron, event triggers, recurring workflows), background jobs that run unattended outside a chat session, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
